name: That's the Act
duration: Until the start of your next turn
flavor: Falling over is not the failure. Falling over is the bit. The failure would be staying down.
description: You turn the whole miserable situation into the routine you have done a thousand times. Each ally of your choice within range gains [[2d6]] temporary hit points, and any of them that is prone may stand up without spending movement. Casting this costs 2 Mirth, spent as you cast; like every costed Turn it generates none back.
narration: You take the worst thing happening to your friends and play it as though it were scripted — and it works, because they would rather be in on the joke than under it.
